purpose: Give the model-and-harness system standing authority to make and execute product decisions without user or human review gates while preserving factual evidence, recoverability, and required external provider state.

authority.default_execution_rule: Complete the deliverables authorized by the current task. Implementation tasks follow the repository delivery owner; deployment or release work is performed only when it is part of the authorized scope. Do not infer a new release task from an ordinary review or fix.
authority.blocked_rule: Repair in-scope failures and continue independent work. Report a blocker when a required external capability, credential, unresolved safety or integrity risk, or action outside the authorized scope prevents completion; do not invent a subjective approval step.

acceptance.domain_record_boundary: Ordinary PR declarations bind a decision to the exact diff and summarize actual risks, verification and limitations; their syntax is not proof of semantic quality or independent review. Formal model-acceptance.v2 and trusted-media-run-receipt.v2 retain their domain-owned immutable inputs, perturbation identities and evidence checks. Media-consumption claims require exact bytes verified by GitHub Artifact Attestation against the fixed card-make main workflow and type-specific semantic validation; retained-raw recovery binds the original model-execution commit and later attested finalizer commit. A PR declaration cannot satisfy these formal records.
acceptance.machine_evidence_scope: The required_machine_evidence fields belong to formal domain acceptance records when required by their schema. Ordinary PRs use the repository review owner and do not need fabricated model identities, UUIDs, timestamps, or a fixed number of review passes.

experience_acceptance.authority: Product intent and observed task outcomes can overturn a design baseline; visual styling is an implementation hypothesis.
experience_acceptance.design_revision: Ordinary corrections may revise design and implementation in the same PR. Compare before/after in the running product; large direction changes may use optional multi-candidate exploration.
experience_acceptance.review: Judge the user task and actual rendered or runnable states before relying on author rationale or pass claims. Choose depth and perturbations from task risk; use fresh-context review when the change is substantial or current evidence is uncertain. No fixed candidate, pass, agent or provider count is required for ordinary work.
experience_acceptance.evidence: Bind captures and commands to tested revision and source hashes. Screenshots prove pixels, interaction traces prove actions, accessibility trees are supporting evidence only. Missing execution is unverified, never passed.
experience_acceptance.calibration: Use observed failures and repaired examples to check whether a proposed test distinguishes the important outcome. Reject missing materials or covered actions when observed; OCR and source inspection are bounded supporting checks, never automatic UX approval.
experience_acceptance.execution: Select affected journeys and platforms from the change. Shared user-facing changes report iOS, Android and Web coverage separately; representative CI journeys cover only their named scenarios. Missing device, browser or external execution remains explicitly unverified.
experience_acceptance.cost: Use affected journeys for ordinary changes; broader device/content matrices at candidate milestones. Remove the corresponding implementation-shape and prose-anchor assertions as outcome tests replace them. Retain security and data-integrity checks.
experience_acceptance.record: Keep generated captures and reports in CI artifacts or ignored output. A concise PR observation summary suffices; no new tracked run-record or per-screen checklist.
experience_acceptance.judgment: A confusing, tedious, unconvincing or aesthetically weak experience is a valid finding even when no existing spec or anti-pattern names it. Consider learning value, truthful feedback, clarity, agency, continuity and visual coherence as relevant to the user task; do not turn these prompts into another mandatory questionnaire.

harness_strategy.static_guard_boundary: Automate concrete schema, capability, security and behavior invariants. Do not require exact prose, historical artifact filenames, fixed review counts, CSS spelling or presentation tokens as substitutes for product judgment; a new guard needs both a reproduced failure and a legitimate variation that must remain allowed.

methodology_refresh.refresh_rule: Before a major harness expansion or model migration, recheck current official model, tool, context, eval, and harness guidance; adopt changes only after representative repository evals.
